note: Candidate classes per project type, NOT a fixed top 3. The order here is only a default suggestion based on typical impact. Each engagement's threat model decides the real top 3: pick max 3 from the list for that type, reorder by reward, scope, and evidence already on record for that project. Do not copy the top 3 from another type. If a class name in the threat model does not match exactly, the mutator matches through the 'match' field (keywords).

candidates.impact: Total loss of all funds, all chains: a leaked key, or a key used without auth.
candidates.name: Key & seed

candidates.impact: Funds lost in one tap: what is shown differs from what is signed, replay across chains.
candidates.name: Signing & transaction display

candidates.impact: Backup or export without re-auth, leaked recovery phrase, bypassed auth.
candidates.name: Auth, recovery & backup

candidates.impact: A door to keys and signing: a malicious dApp, link, or QR code injects a request.
candidates.name: Entry paths: deep link / QR / WebView / WalletConnect

candidates.impact: A website or dependency is used to reach the wallet, impact is conditional.
candidates.name: Platform & supply chain

candidates.impact: Access to another account's data or actions: projects, files, payouts, budgets.
candidates.name: Tenant isolation & IDOR

candidates.impact: Money moves without payment, prices or payouts are manipulated, limits are bypassed.
candidates.name: Business logic: payment / pricing / payout

candidates.impact: Privilege escalation, someone else's session is used, access still works after revoke.
candidates.name: Auth, session & privilege escalation

candidates.impact: Someone else's files are downloaded, an upload becomes execution or traversal.
candidates.name: File upload / download & access

candidates.impact: Approval or verification steps are skipped, state is reversed without authorization.
candidates.name: Workflow / state-machine bypass

candidates.impact: An integration event or token is used for access or actions across accounts.
candidates.name: Integration / webhook / OAuth

candidates.impact: Minting without backing, double settlement, funds out exceed the deposit.
candidates.name: Settlement accounting: mint / burn / fund conservation

candidates.impact: Stale or fake prices are used to settle, fees or limits are manipulated.
candidates.name: Oracle / price / fee manipulation

candidates.impact: One deposit settles many times, a signature is reused across orders or chains.
candidates.name: Attestation / signature replay & idempotency

candidates.impact: Another solver claims someone else's fill, an order is executed without being the chosen resolver.
candidates.name: Executor / solver claiming & access

candidates.impact: An admin role is taken over or used to change destinations or critical parameters.
candidates.name: Admin / roles & upgrade

candidates.impact: Unassumed token behavior breaks accounting or execution.
candidates.name: Token behaviour & external calls
